g.text: The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about. Elf
mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land.
But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to
the people around her? Decades after their victory, the funeral of one her friends confronts Frieren with her
own near immortality. Frieren sets out to fulfill the last…
